English.Char_Desc_2000:
Still-Lane brings gentle, private digital wellbeing and screen time tracking to Windows. Designed specifically for adults managing personal attention, Still-Lane avoids the punitive lockouts of aggressive site blockers and the surveillance architecture of corporate activity monitors.
All tracking data is stored strictly in a local SQLite database on your device and never uploaded to any remote server or employer portal.
Key Features: - Automatic Local Usage Tracking: Accurate timeline of active window focus and application duration. - Gentle, Overridable Limits: Daily time budgets for demanding apps that politely remind you without risking lost unsaved work. - Deep Focus Mode: Dedicated focus blocks with distraction dampening. - Smart Idle Filtering: Distinguishes between active desk work and stepping away. - 100% Private & Autonomous: No employee monitoring, no cloud sync, and one-click data purge/export.
